## feature

## fix

### Occurrence scan allocated the whole hit list before the cap check

```
level: high
```

#### reason

High: silent memory growth proportional to reference repetitiveness, and
a direct violation of the documented cap + 1 bound (README Performance,
AGENTS.md bounded-memory constraint).

#### description

```
type: text
```

`_scan_contig` is now a generator and `_global_occurrences` checks the
cap after every occurrence, returning at cap + 1 — the scan also stops
mid-contig instead of finishing it, which made the rescue benchmark 32%
faster with byte-identical outputs.

#### before

```text
20 kb poly-A contig, cap 10: _scan_contig allocated 19,999 hits;
_global_occurrences returned 19,999 placements, truncated=True afterwards
```

#### after

```text
same input: 11 placements allocated, truncated=True; the generator is
abandoned at the 11th hit and the contig scan never finishes
```

#### evidence

```
level: high
type: text
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
Regression: `tests/test_rescue.py::TestScanPrimitives::test_occurrence_scan_bounded_at_cap_plus_one`;
the chunked-scan test now also pins the generator contract.
:::

### Cross-contig rescue relocated templates with secondary records

```
level: medium
```

#### reason

Medium: documented exclusion violated on one path; relocated primaries
left the untouched secondary pointing at an abandoned locus.

#### description

```
type: text
```

`rescue_eligible` takes `has_non_primary` and both call sites pass it, so
the exclusion runs before any search or record mutation on every path —
the cross-contig path previously reached relocation without any merge
gate.

#### before

```text
cross-contig MAPQ-0 pair + secondary: primaries moved to seq1 with ZR:i:1,
reason non_primary_records; secondary kept seq2 with stale mate fields
```

#### after

```text
same input: primaries stay at seq2:0/seq1:2 without ZR, secondary
untouched, reason different_contig
```

#### evidence

```
level: high
type: text
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
Regression: `tests/test_rescue.py::TestNonPrimaryGuard::test_cross_contig_secondary_blocks_rescue`.
:::

### Off-header reference contigs were invisible to uniqueness

```
level: medium
```

#### reason

Medium: false uniqueness — the requirement's negative case speaks of
reference placements, and a duplicate copy outside the BAM header is one.

#### description

```
type: text
```

`_contig_keys` gives header contigs their BAM tid and off-header FASTA
contigs unique negative keys; occurrence scans cover every reference
contig, off-header occurrences count toward ambiguity and the candidate
cap, and the rescue decision requires exactly one compatible joint pair
reference-wide that is also placeable. (The reviewer's alternative of
hard-rejecting an incomplete reference dictionary was refuted: extra
FASTA contigs are benign and common, and one rescue-eligible template
would abort an otherwise valid run.)

#### before

```text
FASTA {seq1=AACC, seq2=AATT, dup=AACC}, header without dup:
merged seq1:1 AACC ZR:1 — rescued as unique
```

#### after

```text
same input: unmerged, rescue_ambiguous, originals kept, no ZR;
a unique pair existing only off-header reports rescue_no_compatible_pair
```

#### evidence

```
level: high
type: text
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
Regressions: `TestOffHeaderContigs::test_fasta_only_duplicate_blocks_uniqueness`
and `TestOffHeaderContigs::test_unique_off_header_pair_not_rescued`.
:::

level: high

#### reason

unchanged reproduction inputs.

#### description

```
type: table
```

| Gate | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `pixi run test` | 176 passed (was 172; +4 regressions) |

| Reproduction 2 (cross-contig + secondary) | nothing relocated, no `ZR`, reason `different_contig` |
| Reproduction 3 (off-header duplicate) | unmerged, `rescue_ambiguous` |

## observation

### Generator early-stop made rescue 32% faster, not just bounded

```
level: medium
```

#### reason

Medium: an unplanned but material improvement; recorded so future
comparisons use the right baseline.

#### description

```
type: table
```

| Run (24,000 templates, 2 Mbp reference, 1 thread) | Seconds | Peak RSS |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Pre-fix (list-collecting scan) | 76.1 | 225 MiB |
| Post-fix (generator, cap + 1 early stop) | 52.0 | 226 MiB |

Outputs are byte-identical between the two runs (same classification
counts and merge reasons). The speedup comes from truncated searches
abandoning the contig mid-scan instead of finishing it.

#### evidence

```
level: high
type: table
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
`/tmp/plbench-rescue` (pre-fix) and `/tmp/plbench-rescue2` (post-fix);
both directories kept outside the repo.
:::

## process

### Reproduce, agree/refute, wait for approval, fix as one batch

```
status: right
```

#### description

```
type: text
```

1. All three findings reproduced with a scratch script before any code
   change; agreement stated with evidence, one fix alternative refuted
   (hard-rejecting incomplete reference dictionaries), and implementation
   waited for the user's explicit go-ahead.
2. Fixes applied as one batch; each finding pinned by a regression test
   derived from its reproduction; all three reproductions re-run at the
   original sites show the corrected behavior.
3. Docs updated in the same change: README (search scope, bounded scan,
   before-search non-primary exclusion, test count) and AGENTS.md
   invariant 10.
4. Rescue benchmark re-run — which surfaced the 32% improvement as a
   side effect, with identical outputs verifying no behavior change.

#### evidence

```
level: high
type: text
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
Plan: `docs/plans/20261022-113918_review-fixes-6.plan.qmd`; reproduction
scripts under `/tmp` (kept outside the repo).
:::
